# Full Knowledge Base: Michael Mercier Tennis & Pickleball Coaching

- **Title**: USPTA Certified Master Professional & Tennis/Pickleball Director

- **Primary Geographic Base**: Beverly, Massachusetts (North Shore of Boston)

- **Virtual Video Review Rate**: $75 per evaluation (60-sec video breakdown with voiceover)

- **Seasonal Availability**: Year-round (outdoors in spring/summer/fall; indoors in winter at Bass River Tennis Club in Beverly and other regional indoor venues)

## 2. Key Accreditations & Honors
- **USPTA Certified Master Professional**: The highest certification level recognized in professional tennis coaching, held by fewer than 1% of tennis professionals worldwide.
- **Head Tennis Professional at Harvard University for 20+ Years**: Instructed over 100,000 Harvard alumni, students, family, and university affiliates. Oversaw the Murr Center and Beren Tennis Center instructional operations, club teams, and racquet customization.
- **USPTA New England Hall of Fame Inductee**: Inducted for exceptional lifetime contributions to tennis instruction and player development across New England.
- **USPTA Lifetime Achievement Award**: Bestowed by the United States Professional Tennis Association.
- **USTA New England Gardner Ward Chase Memorial Award**: The highest individual honor presented by USTA New England, recognizing outstanding lifetime contributions and dedication to growing the game of tennis in New England.
- **Executive Leadership**: Served as Treasurer of the USPTA New England Division.
- **Adaptive Sports Leadership**: Led and supported community outreach programs including Tenacity Boston, Special Olympics New England, Wheelchair Tennis, and Spaulding Rehabilitation Hospital therapeutic tennis programs.

## 3. Services and Pricing
1. **Private Tennis Instruction (Juniors & Adults) - $150/hr**:
   - Stroke biomechanics (modern kinetic chain forehand, two-handed/one-handed backhand).
   - High-percentage serve mechanics (continental grip, trophy pose, leg drive, forearm pronation).
   - Slow-motion 240fps video stroke review and diagnosis.
   - Court geometry, point construction, and mental toughness.
2. **Private & Semi-Private Pickleball Instruction - $150/hr ($75/person)**:
   - The Third Shot Drop mechanics, apex control, and transition footwork.
   - Non-Volley Zone (kitchen line) patience, dinking control, and reset mechanics.
   - Transitioning tennis players from excessive power to high-percentage soft touch.
   - Doubles stacking, court coverage, and poaching communication.
3. **Junior High-Performance & College Recruiting Pathway - $150/hr**:
   - High school varsity preparation (Northeastern Conference, Cape Ann League, Merrimack Valley Conference).
   - Universal Tennis Rating (UTR) optimization and tournament scheduling.
   - Honest, experienced college tennis recruitment guidance from a 20-year Harvard pro.
4. **Virtual Video Stroke Evaluation - $75 per evaluation**:
   - Remote 240fps slow-motion telestration and voiceover video analysis delivered within 48 hours.
5. **Adult League Doubles Strategy & Clinics - $150/hr**:
   - Positioning, covering the middle, Australian and "I" formations, and net poaching.
6. **Professional Racquet Stringing & Customization**:
   - Electronic constant-pull stringing, arm-friendly tension balancing, and pickleball paddle weighting.
